items.name: ContinuousAt.eventually_lt
items.type: {α : Type u} {β : Type v} [TopologicalSpace α] [LinearOrder α] [OrderClosedTopology α] {f g : β → α} [TopologicalSpace β] {x₀ : β} (hf : ContinuousAt f x₀) (hg : ContinuousAt g x₀) (hfg : f x₀ < g x₀) : ∀ᶠ (x : β) in nhds x₀, f x < g x

items.name: EMetric.continuousAt_iff'
items.type: {β : Type v} {α : Type u_2} [PseudoEMetricSpace α] [TopologicalSpace β] {f : β → α} {b : β} : ContinuousAt f b ↔ ∀ ε > 0, ∀ᶠ (x : β) in nhds b, edist (f x) (f b) < ε

items.name: Metric.continuousAt_iff'
items.type: {α : Type u} {β : Type v} [PseudoMetricSpace α] [TopologicalSpace β] {f : β → α} {b : β} : ContinuousAt f b ↔ ∀ ε > 0, ∀ᶠ (x : β) in nhds b, dist (f x) (f b) < ε
